sections: A booking page your clients can use without the back and forth.

Guest booking without a client login

sections: Bookings are only the starting point.

Manage the client relationship around the appointment.

sections: Built for the way independent service businesses work here.

NextSlot is a South African product built around appointment-based service businesses. The goal is not to copy a generic global booking app. It is to give local independent operators practical tools for bookings, payments, clients and business performance.
ZAR pricing and local payment workflows
Online booking for independent service businesses
Local payment options are part of the product.
Payment needs vary by business and plan. NextSlot supports PayShap for instant bank-to-bank payment flows and online card checkout through supported providers including Yoco, iKhokha and PayFast.
Mobile service businesses are supported too.

Many independent operators do not work from one permanent location. NextSlot can support mobile appointments with call-out and travel information, while keeping the same booking and client records in the system.
fit: You run an independent service business in South Africa.
You need online bookings and local payment options.
You work from a location, travel to clients, or combine both.
You want business insights without moving to an enterprise system.

sections: Build a client record from real appointments.
Every booking gives the business more context. NextSlot keeps booking history with the client so you can understand previous visits without searching through old messages.
Client list with search and filtering
Keep useful details where the business can use them.
For businesses that need more context around a service, NextSlot supports consultation records and client alerts. The next appointment can start with the information you already have.
Blocked clients and reasons where enabled
Retention becomes part of the workflow.

sections: See the business behind the bookings.
The dashboard brings revenue and booking activity into view so the owner can see what is happening without building reports manually.

A monthly revenue number tells you what happened. Booking patterns help explain why. NextSlot uses booking activity to show demand across days and time windows so you can see where the business is filling and where gaps remain.
Nexty turns patterns into questions worth answering.

Nexty is the intelligence layer on top of the operational data. It looks across bookings, payments, client activity and other business signals to surface practical growth, retention and operations insights.
fit: You know your revenue but not what is driving it.
You are unsure which services, time slots or channels deserve more attention.
You want to see demand patterns instead of relying on intuition.
You want insights based on your own business activity.

sections: Your business can move without your admin falling apart.
NextSlot supports service businesses that travel to clients. The booking flow can capture the information needed for mobile appointments while the business keeps one client and booking record.
Make travel part of the economics.

Travel takes time and costs money. NextSlot can calculate travel-related charges and keep that information connected to the appointment, helping the owner account for the work involved in getting to the client.
Mobile does not have to mean mobile-only.
A business can operate from a fixed location, travel to clients, or do both. NextSlot adapts to the operating model instead of forcing every service business into the same setup.
fit: You travel to clients for appointments.
Travel time and distance affect what an appointment is worth.
You want call-out fees handled as part of booking.
You operate both mobile and fixed-location services.

sections: A booking is not complete until you know how it is being paid.
NextSlot keeps payment activity connected to the appointment. Depending on the business and plan, clients can pay a deposit or full amount, with outstanding balances tracked against the booking.
Use payment methods that fit the business.
NextSlot supports South African payment workflows across different plans, giving businesses options for bank-to-bank and online card payments.
Less payment chasing after the appointment.

When payment information is part of the booking workflow, the business can see what has been paid and what remains. That reduces the need to reconstruct payment status from messages and separate records.
fit: You chase deposits or balances manually.
Payment status lives somewhere separate from your booking calendar.
You need a deposit before confirming an appointment.
You want local payment options connected to the booking experience.

sections: Growth starts with seeing what is already happening.
NextSlot collects the operational data created by running the business. That gives the owner a clearer view of revenue, bookings, clients, services and demand before asking what should change.
Nexty looks for opportunities in the gaps.
Nexty is designed to be proactive rather than another report you have to remember to check. It looks across the data already in NextSlot and surfaces signals worth paying attention to.
The goal is an action, not another dashboard.
A useful insight should help the owner decide what to investigate, change or test. Nexty connects the pattern to a practical next step where the available data supports one.
Prioritise where attention may have the most value

sections: NextSlot is built around the real work of running a service business.

The product brings bookings, payments, clients, availability and business activity into the same operating picture. It is designed for independent businesses that need useful tools without enterprise complexity.

PhenomeBeauty had been running on WhatsApp bookings, EFT deposits and manual tracking. NextSlot brought booking activity and business performance into view. Over 90 days, NextSlot facilitated bookings and business growth resulting in R63,851.
Mobile beauty business in Cape Town
The product keeps getting built from operator problems.
NextSlot is not positioned as a generic technology platform. It is built around the practical problems independent service businesses face when the owner is also the person doing the work.
fit: You run an independent service business.

You want a clearer view of the business behind your appointments.
